1:
<sp(0)>This is a report on the circumstances
surrounding the return of the #c[5E8FD8]Nadesico#c,
#c[5E8FD8]Macross#c, and #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c to Earth.
2:
<sp(0)>After being folded to Pluto<im(1)> by the fold
system, the three ships began their return
to Earth while completely isolated.
3:
<sp(0)>During this, Misa Hayase, Hikaru Ichijyo
and two civilians were abducted and
questioned by an apparent #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c leader.
4:
<sp(0)>As a result, a great deal of information
regarding the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c was obtained.
5:
<sp(0)>First, they are a race living purely for
battle, and all of them, as soldiers, had
their bodies enhanced for combat.
6:
<sp(0)>Conversely, toward culture such as songs,
they exhibited reactions of extraordinary
surprise and terror.
7:
<sp(0)>Furthermore, to the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c, the
coexistence of men and women appears to
be an astounding circumstance.
8:
<sp(0)>The #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c are an all-male military,<im(2)>
and have long been at war with the<im(3)>
all-female #c[BE5050]Meltrandi#c force.
9:
<sp(0)>To them, a difference in sex is inherently
equivalent to being an enemy.
10:
<sp(0)>Moreover, the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c view humanity,
which is utterly alien to them, as an
extremely dangerous threat.
11:
<sp(0)>From this background, it is predicted that
the likelihood of the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c launching a
full Earth invasion is very high.
